Build: Battery Recharge Station
30% of base mana
1.5 sec cast2 min cooldown
Build a Battery Recharge Station for 30 sec that allies can interact with once to replenish 15% maximum health and mana, and 50% maximum Rage, Energy, Focus, and Runic Power.

Applies Depleting Battery to party and raid members within 40 yds.

Depleting Battery
Movement speed increased by 10% for 30 sec. Run to the Battery Recharge Station and charge your battery!

Charged Battery
Movement speed increased by 30% for 12 sec.
